keywords: Engineers who think and act on their own 2.Social responsibility 3.Global society 4.Innovation 5.Career design
educationalGoal: To become “engineers who think and act on their own” and play an active role in global society, it is necessary to be interested in social movements, acquire basic/specialized academic skills, and be conscious of career design. In this course, students will learn about the attitude of engineers, their roles in companies, their responsibility to society, and innovation.
advice: Students will: (1) Learn about the work contents, responsibilities, and rewards of engineers working in companies active in the global environment. (2) Learn about development, design, production, maintenance, and sales processes, and laws related to work. (3) Understand that there are various industries in society, and that engineers are active in various occupations. (4) Understand the work of engineers, risk prediction training, and life plans through lectures and exercises. (5) Understand the work of engineers through videos, group discussions, and announcements. (6) Learn innovation cases to contribute to social development.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge and related subjects learned in the first year Basic knowledge about social structure and movements Basic knowledge about the relationship between Japan and the world

activityGoals.body: Be able to express social trends in simple sentences.
Be able to understand the responsibilities and rewards of engineers.
Be able to describe the differences between engineers and technicians in your own words.
Be able to understand your life plan and be able to present your own opinions at group discussions.
Be able to understand how to become an engineer who contributes to society.
